title: 当"银信"在雅加达响起：一部潮汕方言片为何牵动印尼华人
subtitle: 《给阿嬷的情书》（Dear You）8月7日在印尼公映，华社侨团公益包场；一部讲"侨批"与"下南洋"的潮汕方言片，为何唤起整个南洋华人的共同记忆？
summary: 8月7日，潮汕方言电影《给阿嬷的情书》（Dear You）在印尼正式公映，多家华社、商会、侨团与中资企业组织公益包场，华侨华人在乡音乡情中重温"下南洋"往事。本文以这部2026年现象级华语片为切入点，介绍其以世界记忆遗产"侨批"为叙事线索、串联潮汕与南洋两代人情感旅程的故事，并分析"侨批叙事"为何能跨越方言与国界，唤起印尼乃至整个东南亚华人的集体记忆。文章指出，侨团包场本质是社区记忆的集体再生产，而当华人已"落地生根"的今天，共同的"下南洋"记忆仍是连接不同世代、连接中国与海外华人社会的柔软桥梁。
imageAlt: 雅加达唐人街的市井街景，行人穿梭于老式骑楼与摊位之间，呈现南洋华人社区的日常烟火气。

en.title: When "silver letters" echo in Jakarta: why a Teochew-dialect film moves Indonesia's Chinese
en.subtitle: Dear You (《给阿嬷的情书》) premiered in Indonesia on 7 August with charitable group screenings by Chinese associations; how does a Teochew film about qiaopi and 'going to Nanyang' awaken a shared memory across the Nanyang Chinese world?
en.summary: On 7 August 2026, the Teochew-dialect film Dear You (《给阿嬷的情书》) officially premiered in Indonesia, with multiple Chinese associations, chambers, overseas-Chinese organizations and Chinese enterprises organizing charitable group screenings, letting ethnic Chinese revisit the 'going to Nanyang' past in familiar dialect. Taking this 2026 breakout Mandarin-language film as a starting point, this piece introduces its story — built around the Memory-of-the-World heritage qiaopi and linking two generations across Teochew and Nanyang — and analyzes why the 'qiaopi narrative' crosses dialect and border to awaken a collective memory among Indonesians and Southeast Asian Chinese at large. It argues that the associations' block bookings are, in essence, a collective reproduction of community memory, and that even as Chinese have 'taken root locally,' the shared 'going to Nanyang' memory remains a soft bond linking generations and connecting Chinese societies in China and abroad.
en.imageAlt: A street scene in Jakarta's Chinatown, with people moving among old shophouses and stalls — the everyday texture of a Nanyang Chinese community.

subtitle: 从新山柔佛古庙的九面鼓，到教育部主办的“徽崇杯”——一项华人文化创造如何同时完成在地化与国家化
summary: 2026年8月8日，马来西亚教育部首次以主办方身份举办全国小学二十四节令鼓邀请赛，并以创始人陈徽崇之名命名为“徽崇杯”。16队、417名小鼓手，其中非华族逾一成。真正的新闻不是办了比赛，而是谁来办：一项1988年由华人在新山创造的鼓艺，用38年从社团自筹走进了国家教育体制。它之所以能被接纳，在于本地原创、无语言门槛、已有352支队伍的群众基础——而这三点同时也是它的天花板。

en.title: Thirty-Eight Years to Enter the System: Malaysia's 24 Festive Drums Joins the National Education Fold
en.subtitle: From nine drums at a Johor Bahru temple to a ministry-run “Hooi Chong Cup” — how a Chinese-Malaysian invention completed both its localisation and its nationalisation
en.summary: On 8 August 2026 Malaysia's Ministry of Education convened, in its own name, the first national primary-school 24 Festive Drums invitational, naming it the “Hooi Chong Cup” after co-founder Tan Hooi Chong. Sixteen teams, 417 young drummers, more than 10 per cent of them non-Chinese. The news is not that a competition took place but who convened it: a drum art created by Chinese Malaysians in Johor Bahru in 1988 took 38 years to move from community funding into the state education system. It was accepted because it is homegrown, carries no language barrier, and already had 352 school troupes — the same three conditions that define its ceiling.
en.imageAlt: Uniformed drummers in sashes lined up mid-performance, echoing the collective form of the 24 Festive Drums.

summary: 2026年8月9日，马来西亚内政部长赛夫丁称难民经难民署安置到美国等第三国已“非常渺茫”，政府启动身份筛查为遣返原籍国铺路，首批对象是扣留营内逾4000名缅甸公民。算术是残酷的：马国登记难民逾21万，2025年全年仅2585人完成安置或遣返，年清空率约1.2%。从扣留营起步筛查在行政上高效，在保护标准上却最可疑；“别只说罗兴亚人”的正名亦把无国籍这一最难案子溶进了易案。压力回流过境国，本质是国际保护体系退潮后的必然回声。

en.title: When the Third-Country Door Closes: Malaysia Starts “Screening for Return” on 4,000 Myanmar Nationals
en.subtitle: From vanishing resettlement to organised repatriation — how a non-signatory state is filling a legal vacuum with administrative procedure
en.summary: On 9 August 2026 Malaysian Home Minister Saifuddin Nasution said resettlement to third countries such as the United States had become “very slim,” and launched status screening to prepare returns, starting with 4,000-plus Myanmar nationals in immigration depots. The arithmetic is brutal: more than 215,000 registered refugees, but only 2,585 resettled or repatriated in all of 2025 — about 1.2 per cent a year. Screening from inside detention is administratively efficient and, by protection standards, the most suspect starting point; the push to say “Myanmar refugees” rather than “Rohingya” also dissolves the hardest case, statelessness, into the easier ones. Pressure flowing back to transit states is the echo of a receding global protection system.
en.imageAlt: People gathered and waiting at a Kuala Lumpur roadside, echoing the situation of refugees and migrant workers in Malaysia.

en.title: Two Hours a Day: How a Philippine Classroom Timetable Became a Security File
en.subtitle: The Philippine defense secretary, citing an American think-tank report, has filed Chinese-language teacher training under national security. A dispute about Mandarin lessons is reopening a question the Philippines sealed fifty years ago.
en.summary: On 29 July 2026, Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr., citing a US think-tank SeaLight report, branded Jinan University's teacher training for Philippine Chinese schools as 'huge evidence' of schools being misused, prompting the cancellation of a three-week August fieldwork. The irony this essay notes: the Philippines' 148 Chinese schools and 70,000 students are community-funded, yet the two-hour daily Mandarin cap was set by Manila's own 1973 Filipinization decree. Using four symmetry criteria — disclosure, capacity, coercion, consent — the piece questions the methodological basis of the securitization narrative.
en.imageAlt: Pedestrians going about their day on a Manila street. Binondo, the surrounding district, is recognised as the world's oldest Chinatown, where the Chinese community has built schools, hospitals and businesses for over four centuries.

title: 从"落叶归根"到"落地生根"：印尼华裔总会换届背后的身份之变
subtitle: 黄印华履新印尼华裔总会（INTI）2026—2030年度总主席，一句"落叶归根"到"落地生根"，道出全球最大华侨华人聚居国数十年的身份之变。
summary: 8月7日，印尼华裔总会（INTI）新一届理监事会在雅加达就职，黄印华履新2026—2030年度总主席。他提出的"过去讲落叶归根，现在更多讲落地生根"，折射出印尼——全球华侨华人人口最多国家——华人身份认同数十年的静默变迁。本文从INTI成立于1998年排华事件之后的历史背景切入，梳理华人社团从维权到融入的角色演变，并分析中国崛起如何赋予新一代华人"更有底气"的双重身份；INTI作为中印尼民间桥梁，其价值在于双向互信的累积，而青年接棒则是老牌侨社共同面临的代际挑战。

en.title: From "returning to the roots" to "taking root locally": the quiet shift in Indonesia's ethnic-Chinese identity
en.subtitle: Huang Yinhua assumes the 2026–2030 chairmanship of Indonesia's Chinese Association (INTI); his 'falling leaves return to roots' to 'take root locally' captures a decades-long identity shift in the world's largest overseas-Chinese population.
en.summary: On 7 August 2026, the new board of the Indonesian Chinese Association (INTI) was inaugurated in Jakarta, with Huang Yinhua assuming the 2026–2030 chairmanship. His remark — 'In the past we spoke of falling leaves returning to their roots; now we speak more of taking root where we stand' — reflects the slow, decades-long transformation of ethnic-Chinese identity in Indonesia, home to the world's largest overseas-Chinese population. Tracing INTI's founding in the aftermath of the 1998 anti-Chinese riots, this piece maps the association's shift from rights-defense to social integration, and examines how China's rise has given a new generation the 'greater confidence' to hold a dual identity. As a people-to-people bridge between China and Indonesia, INTI's value lies in the accrual of two-way trust, while youth succession remains the shared generational challenge of established diaspora organizations.
en.imageAlt: A Southeast Asian Chinese temple hung with red lanterns and festive bunting, its red-and-gold ornamentation vivid against the greenery — a symbol of Chinese culture taking root and enduring locally.

title: 从妈祖庙到气象预警：当中国方案遇上东南亚的最后一公里
subtitle: 以妈祖命名的中国气象预警方案已落地7国，却尚未进入东南亚——文化最深厚的地区为何成为技术盲区？
summary: 2026年7月上海世界人工智能大会上，中方宣布推动气象智能预警方案妈祖（MAZU）在30国落地。然而截至8月，该系统已在巴基斯坦、吉布提等7国部署、40余国云端使用，东南亚十国却无一正式接入。本文分析这一悖论：东南亚恰恰是全球妈祖信俗最深厚地区，新加坡天福宫、吉隆坡天后宫等数千座宫庙构成现成的社区网络；预警真正的瓶颈不在卫星而在最后一公里；中泰联合实验室的启动标志东南亚破局开始；华侨华人的宫庙与会馆网络可作为官方预警的有益补充——前提是在WMO单一权威声音原则下合法合规运作。
imageAlt: 一名信众在传统中式寺庙的香炉前上香祈祷，香烟袅袅升起，象征妈祖信仰跨越千年的守护精神。

en.title: From Mazu Temples to Early Warning Systems: When China's MAZU Meets Southeast Asia's Last Mile
en.subtitle: China's Mazu-named early warning system is live in seven countries — yet absent from Southeast Asia, where Mazu belief runs deepest. Why?
en.summary: At WAIC 2026 in Shanghai, China announced it would deploy its MAZU meteorological early warning solution in 30 countries. Yet as of August 2026, while MAZU operates in Pakistan, Djibouti and five other nations with cloud access in 40+ countries, no Southeast Asian state has formally onboarded. This piece examines the paradox: Southeast Asia is precisely where Mazu folk religion is most deeply rooted, with thousands of temples from Singapore's Thian Hock Keng to Ho Chi Minh City's Thien Hau Pagoda forming a ready community network. The real bottleneck in early warning is not satellites but the last mile; the China-Thailand joint laboratory marks Southeast Asia's entry point; and diaspora temple networks could supplement official warnings — within legal bounds under WMO's Single Authoritative Voice principle.
en.imageAlt: A worshipper prays before an incense burner at a traditional Chinese temple, smoke rising gently — symbolizing Mazu's thousand-year legacy of protection.

summary: 2026年8月初全国侨务工作会议重申，保护海外华侨正当权益是侨务工作“重中之重”。本文从法律与战略双重视角解读：宪法与《领事保护与协助条例》构成保护基石，也门、苏丹、黎巴嫩等撤离行动是最实在的后盾；西方将中国侨务污名化为“干涉内政”，实为“中国威胁论”翻版与双重标准。在东南亚这一华侨最集中区域，依法保护侨胞既是国家义务，也是民心相通的战略资产。

en.title: At the Heart of China's Diaspora Work: The Legal and Strategic Logic of Protecting Overseas Chinese
en.subtitle: From constitutional duty to dedicated legislation, and the Western double standard — reading the legal and strategic logic of China's diaspora work
en.summary: A conference in early August 2026 reaffirmed that protecting overseas Chinese is the 'top priority' of diaspora work. This piece reads it from legal and strategic angles: the Constitution and the 2023 Consular Protection and Assistance Regulations form the bedrock, while evacuations from Yemen, Sudan, and Lebanon are the concrete backstop. Western framing of China's diaspora work as 'interference' is a double-standard reprocessing of the 'China threat' thesis — and, in Southeast Asia, lawful protection is both duty and a strategic asset for people-to-people ties.

en.title: Java's Park Fire and the Cross-Border Haze: Climate, Governance, and ASEAN's Recurring Headache
en.subtitle: From East Java's park fire to Kalimantan's transboundary haze — Southeast Asia's 'tragedy of the commons' in regional governance
en.summary: In early August 2026, a fire broke out in East Java's Bromo Tengger Semeru National Park, burning over 120 hectares; smoke from Kalimantan drifted into Malaysia, pushing Sarawak's air to 'unhealthy' levels (Sibu peaked at 172). Under an El Niño-lengthened dry season, the haze again exposes ASEAN's 'soft-law' bind on transboundary pollution: the fire burns in one country, the cost is shared by many. What lowers the cost is earlier warning, transparent hotspot sharing, and domestic enforcement.

en.title: The "Ghost Projects" Backlash: Philippines GDP Stalls in Q2 Under a Triple Whammy
en.subtitle: An anti-graft probe froze infrastructure, the Middle East shock lifted prices, and the growth model's soft underbelly showed — three short boards pinched at once, and Q2 GDP grew just 2.3%
en.summary: Philippine Q2 GDP grew just 2.3% year-on-year, the weakest since 2009 excluding pandemic years. An anti-graft probe froze 'ghost' infrastructure projects, construction fell 14.8%, and investment declined for a fourth straight quarter; Middle East tensions lifted energy and living costs, slowing household consumption. en.title: Atoms In, Bits Out: Batam's Factories, Manila's Desks, and Southeast Asia's Two-Front Reordering
en.subtitle: The tariff war is pushing physical production into the region while generative AI pulls cognitive work out of it — one external shock, two opposite directions
en.summary: In a single news cycle, Indonesia's Batam emerged as a tariff-driven relocation hub for contract manufacturing while Philippine outsourcing workers were dismissed after training the AI that replaced them. This piece argues the two are one ledger: the same Western cost decisions push atoms into the region and pull bits out of it. Three asymmetries matter — relocation is reversible while automation is not; data centres are capital-intensive while BPO sustained 1.9 million jobs; and the specific engine that built a Filipino middle class has no equivalent in what is arriving.
